en: Vintage monochrome view over a tree‑lined avenue bordered by multi‑story historic buildings and a prominent church‑like structure with two domed towers on the right. The image shows a spa town set in hilly terrain, with more villas and a large complex on the hill in the background. Printed captions in German read "Marienbad. Kaiserstraße." in the upper left and "Egerländer." in the upper right.
